summary: Thelendor returns as a premier carry for Fallen Shadow Spire III in Season 9, even without his exclusive artifact. Equipping him with Dark Corpse Puppet allows him to recover 40% Max HP and 20% Ultimate Energy on every kill, repeatedly resetting his ultimate during wave clears. Paired with a Radiance Rally team of Gladys, Lorentheel, Alton, and Anneliesis, the team achieved an SS score of 28,945 points while taking 0 damage. Thelendor accounted for 500 million damage (87% of total team output).

tips: Equip Dark Corpse Puppet on Thelendor in mob-heavy stages to grant him 20% Ultimate Energy and 40% Max HP recovery on every kill.
Ensure Thelendor has the highest Crit Damage on the team (e.g. 275%) so Gladys marks him for extra damage.
